en: Dependent on a wholesome state that accompanies consciousness, there arises a state that does not accompany consciousness and is not wholesome by way of root-condition (*hetu-paccaya*)... Nine [instances] under root; ... pe ... nine under non-disappearance (*avigata*).

Dependent on an unwholesome state that accompanies consciousness, there arises a state that does not accompany consciousness and is not unwholesome by way of root-condition... Nine under root; ... pe ... nine under non-disappearance. (The indeterminate root has only three conditions.)
